Act3-3#1.zh: (大郎是疯了吗？放着白花花的三千贯不赚，还把银子们放了？好，你不赚我赚！)
Act3-3#1.t: (Has the young master gone mad? Turning down three thousand strings of good silver and letting the money walk away? Fine. If you won't take it, I will!)

Act3-3#3.zh: 小人李吉，家居史家村，以打猎维生。
Act3-3#3.t: Your humble servant Li Ji, of Shi Family Village. I make my living hunting.

Act3-3#4.t: Well, what have you come to report?

Act3-3#5.zh: 大爷明鉴。托大爷的鸿福，少华山三个强盗的下落已经知道了。
Act3-3#5.t: Your Honour, thanks to your great fortune, I've found out where the three Mount Shaohua robbers are.

Act3-3#7.zh: 那三个强盗正在史家村跟史进饮酒作乐、称兄道弟呢！
Act3-3#7.t: Those three robbers are drinking and feasting with Shi Jin in Shi Family Village, calling each other brothers!

Act3-3#8.zh: 岂有此理！身为村长，居然跟山贼狼狈为奸？！国家有此种仓中之鼠，哪会安定？！来人啊！马上集合部队，由我亲自带兵讨贼！
Act3-3#8.t: Outrageous! A village headman, in league with mountain bandits?! With rats like that in the granary, how can the country have peace?! Men! Assemble the troops at once. I'll lead them against the bandits myself!

Act3-3#9.zh: 大爷，那么那三千贯的奖赏...
Act3-3#9.t: Your Honour, and the three thousand strings of reward...

Act3-3#10.zh: 等到捉住史进一伙人之后，我不会亏待你的。现在，还需要你帮我们带路。
Act3-3#10.t: Once we've caught Shi Jin and his gang, you'll be well rewarded. For now I need you to show us the way.

Act3-3#12.zh: 李吉出卖史进，官府举兵进犯史家村。
Act3-3#12.t: Li Ji betrays Shi Jin, and the county sends troops against Shi Family Village.
